normalization_plan.reason: quality is only used inside buy for the price multiplication and stock bound checks, so it can be folded into buy
referrer is solely consumed by buy to update referrerContrib and totalReferrerContrib
amount is only used inside withdraw for the share split and residual transfer
receivers only drives the airdrop loop and the totalClaimableAmount reduction
randomIdx is the sole index argument passed into _pickLocation and has no independent meaning
newPrice is immediately written into boxPrice by setBoxPrice
newAddress is immediately written into randomGeneratorAddress by setRandomGenerator
seed is a loop-local accumulator inside boxesAward used only to derive randomIdx
